versos.texto_bv: O SENHOR desferiu um golpe entre os homens de Bete-Semes porque eles olharam para a arca do SENHOR. Feriu, entre o povo, setenta homens, cinquenta mil homens. O povo ficou de luto, porque o SENHOR o havia atingido com um grande golpe.
versos.traducao_literal: E feriu entre os homens de Bete-Semes, porque olharam na arca do SENHOR; e feriu no povo setenta homens, cinquenta mil homens; e enlutou-se o povo, porque feriu o SENHOR no povo um golpe grande.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Divergência textual significativa nos números: a BV lê “setenta homens, cinquenta mil homens” como dois grupos separados; a NTLH lê apenas “setenta homens”; ARA e NVIPT leem “cinquenta mil e setenta homens” como um único número combinado (50.070). Trata-se de questão de crítica textual (variantes manuscritas do hebraico) que excede o escopo de revisão de forma. — evidência: NTLH: “Setenta homens de Bete-Semes olharam para dentro da arca da aliança, e por isso o SENHOR os matou”; ARA: “feriu do povo cinqüenta mil e setenta homens”; NVIPT: “matando setenta deles”.

kjv.texto: And he smote the men of Beth–shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the Lord, even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men: and the people lamented, because the Lord had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter.

vizinhos.18: And the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fenced cities, and of country villages, even unto the great stone of Abel, whereon they set down the ark of the Lord: which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua, the Beth–shemite.
vizinhos.20: And the men of Beth–shemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy Lord God? and to whom shall he go up from us?

web.texto: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck of the people fifty thousand seventy men; and the people mourned, because Yahweh had struck the people with a great slaughter.

vizinhos.18: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone, whereon they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
vizinhos.20: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”
